title: Time to CASH OUT! 4 Stocks to SELL Before Earnings!
summary: Curated YouTube transcript reviewed as untrusted lead material. It presents earnings-season opinions and unverified valuation, competition, operating, and price-path claims. Existing registered primary evidence supports only narrower maintained context for CrowdStrike, PayPal, SoFi, and Bloom Energy; no video-only claim changed an entity conclusion or paper-trading state.
